title: WhatsApp message when a row is added in PGDock
summary: When a new row is added to a table in your PGDock database (an order, a booking, a sign-up), send the phone number in it your approved WhatsApp template.
description: Taskiem asks PGDock for the table's changes itself when you publish, and stops them if you take the workflow down. Each committed insert into the table sends your approved WhatsApp template to the number in the phone column, with the value of the name column as its first body variable. A rolled-back insert sends nothing, and PGDock delivering the same insert twice sends one message. Create and get the template approved in WhatsApp Manager first.

params.name: table
params.title: Table
params.description: The table to watch, as schema.table or table (in public).

params.name: phone_column
params.title: Phone column
params.description: The column holding the number to message, with + and country code.

params.name: name_column
params.title: Name column
params.description: The column whose value fills the template's first body variable.

params.name: template_name
params.title: WhatsApp template
params.description: Your approved template, with one body variable for the name.

params.name: pgdock_connection
params.title: PGDock connection
params.description: The PGDock connection (an API token restricted to the project) whose table is watched.

params.name: whatsapp_connection
params.title: WhatsApp connection
params.description: The name of your WhatsApp Business connection.

definition.name: WhatsApp message when a row is added in PGDock

steps.name: Send the WhatsApp template to the number in the new row
steps.when: =has(trigger.body.record) && trigger.body.record != null && steps.settings.output.phone in trigger.body.record && trigger.body.record[steps.settings.output.phone] != null && string(trigger.body.record[steps.settings.output.phone]) != ''
